metadata.title: SWOT satellite discharge estimates with strict and retained quality-control variants accompanying manuscript v15
metadata.description: Offline bilingual station map and frozen v15 station-model estimates under two satellite-only QC policies. Measured discharge and observation-level ground comparisons are excluded. Strict QC filters whole records before prediction; retained QC preserves all archived records and annotates quality concerns. Both preserve archived cross-date slope substitution and provide retrospective estimates. The dataset and original documentation use CC BY 4.0; software and viewer code are separately licensed under MIT. Author details follow the associated v15 manuscript. This is a local unpublished preparation; no repository URL or DOI has been assigned.
